description: How fast a scheduled workflow gathers its cohort: this many patients are started, then the engine waits, then it starts that many again, until everyone matching has begun. The pace is deliberate - it is what keeps messages leaving at a rate the provider accepts and leaves the workers free for replies in between. A workflow that places CALLS can set a slower interval of its own.

fields.label: Patients started per batch
fields.description: Between 1 and 500. Also how often progress is saved, so a worker that dies mid-batch loses at most this many starts and picks up from the last one.

fields.label: Seconds before the next batch
fields.description: Between 10 and 3600. Batch size divided by this is the rate: 60 patients every 60 seconds is 60 a minute. A single workflow may override this on itself when it dials rather than messages.

name: CRM Cohort Pace Settings
